description:
Perform a log-log regression analysis to estimate the elasticity of tooth growth with respect to Vitamin C dosage.

1. Open the dataset '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ToothGrowth.csv'.
2. Create a new Computed Variable named 'ln_len' using the formula 'LN(len)'.
3. Create a new Computed Variable named 'ln_dose' using the formula 'LN(dose)'.
4. Run a Linear Regression with 'ln_len' as the Dependent Variable and 'ln_dose' as the Covariate (Independent Variable).
5. Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/PowerLaw_Analysis.omv'.
6. Identify the unstandardized regression slope (estimate) for 'ln_dose' and write it to a text file at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/elasticity_report.txt'. The file should contain only the numeric value (e.g., 0.123).
